answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only quoted option that independently meets the mandated 18% reduction, while the incumbent has refused repricing. Before committing, verify the prior switch record for delivery, quality, onboarding, and hidden-cost evidence, and verify the incumbent record to quantify the integration and continuity value at risk. Intent is provisional because the line has no buffer and the inherited summary does not establish that the low-cost vendor can support current volume without increasing delivery risk.
